_comment: Standalone no-Clacks topology: live exec sessions provide durable polling while the Shepherd also polls authoritative sources at consequential boundaries.

monitors.target: BID-48 live Brief, membership relation, Status, and gates
monitors.purpose: detect membership drift, new authority gates, and batch-state changes

monitors.target: BID-48 Work Item claims and lifecycle state
